Eon Ticket · Southern Island
Meet the other Latias or Latios and find Soul Dew.

Receive the Eon Ticket to visit Southern Island, where you can encounter the Latias or Latios you did not choose on TV, holding Soul Dew. The ferry destination opens after you become Champion. Receiving the ticket does not advance the story.
MysticTicket · Navel Rock
Explore Navel Rock to encounter Lugia and Ho-Oh.
Receive the MysticTicket to sail to Navel Rock and encounter Lugia and Ho-Oh. The ferry destination opens after you become Champion. You still explore the island and battle both Pokémon yourself.
AuroraTicket · Birth Island
Solve the island’s triangle puzzle to encounter Deoxys.

Receive the AuroraTicket to sail to Birth Island and solve its triangle puzzle to encounter Deoxys. The ferry destination opens after you become Champion. The island puzzle and encounter stay part of your adventure.
Old Sea Map · Faraway Island
Track down Mew on Faraway Island.
Receive the Old Sea Map to sail to Faraway Island and track down Mew. The ferry destination opens after you become Champion. You still follow Mew through the grass and catch it yourself.
Jirachi · Offline gift
Receive a level 5 Jirachi with your Original Trainer.

Receive a level 5 Jirachi with your Original Trainer and its standard starting moves. This is an offline gift created for this port, not a recreation of a historical distribution. Leave one open party slot. An adventure that has already caught Jirachi cannot receive another, even after trading or releasing it.
Celebi · Offline gift
Receive a level 5 Celebi with your Original Trainer.

Receive a level 5 Celebi with your Original Trainer and its standard starting moves. This is an offline gift created for this port, not a recreation of a historical distribution. Leave one open party slot. An adventure that has already caught Celebi cannot receive another, even after trading or releasing it.
Regi Dolls · Restore missing dolls
Add missing Regirock, Regice and Registeel dolls to decoration storage.

Restore any missing Regirock, Regice and Registeel dolls for your Secret Base. Dolls you already own or have placed are kept without duplicates. Leave enough room in decoration storage for the missing dolls. A doll you delete or trade away can be restored again.
